sentences.text: 1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is accordingly disposed of.

3. The present petition under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:-
"On the facts and circumstances abovementioned is most humbly prayed upon this Hon'ble court that it may be pleased to:
(i) Allow the present Petition and set-a-side the order dated 24.03.2023 passed by the Ld. MM (03), South- West, Dwarka in Protest Petition bearing Criminal Case No.
7864 of 2020 titled as "State vs. Cancellation" ;
(ii) Pass an order directing the Ld. MM (03), South- West, Dwarka reopen the investigation in the No. 15712017 registered at P.S. Bindapur under Sections 420/468/ 471 / 120B IPC and;
(iii) Pass any other order as this Hon'ble Court it may deem fit and This is a digitally signed order.
